words.gloss: with an unquestioned or unsuspected disguise

literal: With an unquestioned appearance, not fearing any eye, and never spilling secrets anywhere, is indeed a capable spy.
translation: A capable spy is one who adopts a disguise that raises no suspicion, shows no fear when stared at, and never reveals secrets under any circumstances.
modern: சந்தேகப்படாத தோற்றத்துடன், யாருடைய பார்வைக்கும் அஞ்சாமல், எவ்விடத்திலும் தன் ரகசியங்களை வெளிப்படுத்தாமல் இருக்க வல்லவனே ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three core attributes of a successful spy. First, they must adopt an appearance or disguise ('கடாஅ உரு') that is so natural it raises no questions or suspicion. Second, even when subjected to intense scrutiny or confronted directly, their eyes must show no fear ('கண்ணஞ்சாது'). Finally, they must have the absolute self-control to never let slip ('உகாஅமை') any secrets or their true identity under any circumstances.
